subject: Enterprise RFP — Commercial appendix: commit tiers & crediting model
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orionfs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@orionfs.com>, procurement@orionfs.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: RFP: request for final commercial appendix (commit tiers / overages)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for your team's continued responsiveness on the RFP. Procurement is consolidating the commercial appendix this week — can you send a finalized version that explicitly spells out: commit tiers (tokens/month), committed unit price per 1k tokens, overage rates for 3 bands (>100%, 100–125%, >125%), discount schedule for multi-year and higher commits, true-up mechanics, and any credits for unused commit? We need the details to include in our supplier evaluation matrix.

Please include an example calculation for a typical Orion workload (avg. 6.5M tokens/month baseline, spiky events up to 30M tokens/month). Also note billing cadence and termination/early-exit language for the commercial appendix.

Target: receive by COB Friday so we can circulate to procurement + legal.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Orion Financial Systems

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orionfs.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: RFP: request for final commercial appendix (commit tiers / overages)

Elena —

Appreciate the note. Attached is our proposed commercial appendix (redwood-commercial-appendix-v3.pdf). Summary of the key commercial points below — I put concrete numbers aligned to the usage banding you asked for and included an example calc for your 6.5M baseline + spikes.

1) Commit tiers (monthly token commit, billed monthly with annual true-up):
   - Tier A: 5M tokens/month — unit price $2.40 per 1k tokens ($0.0024 per token)
   - Tier B: 15M tokens/month — unit price $2.10 per 1k tokens ($0.0021 per token)
   - Tier C: 40M tokens/month — unit price $1.85 per 1k tokens ($0.00185 per token)

2) Overage / burst pricing (applies to monthly consumption above committed tokens):
   - Band 1 (0%–25% over commit): +25% to committed unit price (e.g., Tier B overage = $2.625/1k)
   - Band 2 (25%–100% over commit): +50% to committed unit price
   - Band 3 (>100% over commit): +100% to committed unit price
   Notes: Overages are calculated on monthly usage; if average monthly spikes are frequent we recommend moving to the next commit tier to reduce unit economics.

3) Multi-year and volume discounts:
   - 12-month term: baseline prices above
   - 24-month term: additional 7% off the committed unit price
   - 36-month term: additional 12% off the committed unit price + 30-day price protection for model upgrades
   - Commit-step discounts: when increasing committed tokens by ≥25% mid-term, immediate 3% step discount applied to the new incremental commit

4) Crediting / rollover / refunds:
   - Annual true-up window: 60 days after contract year-end; unused committed tokens may be rolled forward up to 20% of the annual committed volume (one-time rollover, expires at next year-end)
   - No cash refunds for unused commit (standard for committed pricing); credits applied to future invoices per the rollover rules above

5) Billing and invoicing:
   - Monthly invoices based on committed tokens (prepaid for the month) + itemized overages invoiced in next billing cycle
   - Net-30 standard; early-pay discount (2%) available for annual prepay

6) Example (Orion profile):
   - Baseline 6.5M tokens/month → Recommend Tier A (5M) + 1.5M overage → blended unit approx $2.70/1k tokens for months with this pattern
   - Example spike month 30M tokens: If committed = 15M (Tier B), overage = 15M tokens; calculation uses Band 2/3 mix depending on magnitude; rolling to Tier C yields ~25% cost savings on the spike vs using overages. Full workbook in the attached appendix with month-by-month scenarios.

7) Termination / early exit:
   - Standard 90-day termination notice at contract year boundary. Early termination within the initial committed year requires payment for the remaining 50% of committed value for that year (subject to negotiation for extenuating circumstances).

8) SLA / credits for downtime: see attached appendix; commercial credit for SLA misses capped at 10% of monthly invoice for repeated incidents.

We're attaching a worked example and a short decision guide that maps your traffic patterns to recommended commit tiers. If you want, we can prepare an alternate appendix with a step-commit (gradual ramp) and month-by-month suggested increases.

Next steps: if this matches procurement's expectations we can prepare a redline-friendly Word doc and a DocuSign packet.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales — Redwoods Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orionfs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 02:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: RFP: request for final commercial appendix (technical mapping)

Hi Elena — quick technical note to help the example calc:

- Token counting: we measure tokens using the standard tokenizer (GPT-style). For your workloads we mapped an average of 1.1 tokens/character for English plain text.
- Generation vs embeddings: generation (chat/completions) billed by output+input tokens; embeddings billed per embedding request (price shown in appendix as $0.30 per 1k tokens equivalent).
- Typical conversion examples included in the workbook:
   • 1 x 1k-token response at Tier B = $2.10
   • 500 concurrent short inferences (avg 60 tokens each) over an hour -> aggregated token volume calculation shown in sheet 'ConcurrencyExamples'

If you want, we can run a 48-hour sampled estimate from your production traces (we'd need a redacted logs export) to produce a precise recommendation for commit sizing.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orionfs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@orionfs.com>, procurement@orionfs.com
Date: Sat, 8 Aug 2026 11:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: RFP: request for final commercial appendix (questions and redlines)

Rishi / team —

Thanks for the appendix. A few follow-ups from procurement / legal:

1) Rollover: 20% one-time rollover is a good start. Can you confirm if unused rollover credits are applied pro-rata by month or only at year-end?
2) Early termination: the 50% remaining payment is higher than Orion prefers — would you consider a 25% exit fee if we provide 90 days advance notice and have not materially exceeded commits during the year?
3) Overage bands: procurement requests a capped effective overage rate for Band 3 (e.g., never exceed $4.25 per 1k tokens) — is that feasible?
4) Attachments: we've attached our redlines (orion-redlines.docx) — primary commercial changes are the three items above + a request for a 30-day invoice review period before automated collection.

Please reply with company position on the three items and we'll proceed to incorporate for internal approval.

Best,
Elena

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orionfs.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: RFP: request for final commercial appendix (company responses and next steps)

Elena —

Thanks for the clear redlines and the questions. After internal review (Sales + Legal + Finance) here are the positions we can commit to for your redline set: 

1) Rollover timing: Rollover credits are applied at contract year-end (one aggregation point). We will allocate rolled-forward credits pro-rata across the first two months of the new contract year to smooth billing for Orion (e.g., 20% annual rollover -> credits applied 50% month1, 50% month2).

2) Early termination: we can accept reducing the termination exposure to 25% of remaining committed value if Orion commits to a minimum 12-month notice to negotiate an exit (or 90 days plus mutual good-faith mediation). We'll reflect the 25% in the redlined clause and add an exception for material breach by either party.

3) Overage cap: we can cap Band 3 effective overage to $4.25 per 1k tokens for the initial 12-month term for Orion (providing cost predictability for extreme spikes). After year 1, cap tied to CPI + model-cost index unless both parties agree otherwise.

4) Invoice review period: we can accept a 30-day invoice review period prior to automated collection for the first 12 months to help with your internal reconciliation (Finance and Billing will coordinate).

Concession summary: 20% rollover (applied pro-rata first two months), 25% early-exit payment (with mediation exception), Band 3 cap at $4.25/1k for year 1, 30-day invoice review window. In exchange, we ask for a mutual PR clause limiting public disclosure of the commercial terms and a commitment to a 12-month minimum initial contract.

Attached I'll prepare a redlined appendix (Word) and a DocuSign packet if that sounds right. If you confirm, we will send a DocuSign link with the updated commercial appendix and Master Services Agreement.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
